name: Regression: Centered 64x64 character sprites avoid Minecraft UV misclassification and preserve smooth 2.5D lighting
description: Verify drawing a centered character illustration on a 64x64 canvas correctly classifies as a standard 2.5D continuous sprite rather than a Minecraft UV atlas, allowing full spherical/cylindrical normal lighting.

planSteps.description: Click the canvas dimension indicator in the top header (e.g. '32x32')
Click the '64x64' preset button and click 'Apply Resize'
Verify the canvas updates to 64x64 bounds
Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode is filled, and draw a centered bunny/character silhouette with empty side flanks
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab in the right inspector panel
Click the 'Analyze & Light Bulb' button in the 2.5D Photometric Studio section
Verify the light gizmo mounts with full 3D curved spherical lighting across the centered character rather than flat UV plane normals
Click 'Cancel (Esc)' on the light gizmo to dismiss
